verdict.rationale: Checkout.com's MCP server lets an agent 'query payment statuses, issue refunds, void payments, and create and manage payment links' via API/IDE, and Payment Links API docs support creating links with pricing programmatically. However, there is no evidence of a 'product' or 'price' catalog object being provisioned (Checkout.com is a payments processor, not a billing/catalog system) — the story implies product/price/payment-link provisioning akin to Stripe's product catalog, which isn't documented here. missing for 10: evidence of a product/price catalog API or object, confirmation the MCP server or API can create such catalog entities alongside payment links in one session, and an end-to-end hands-on example of an agent completing all three steps.
